shots.description: Title screen: the player stands on a street corner at the edge of the city, towers ahead, start overlay up.
Driving: the player cruises down a long avenue in a stolen car, traffic ahead, chase camera behind.
Police chase: two pursuit cars on the player's bumper, sirens flashing, three wanted stars.
Mission: the player on foot at the gold beacon for The Big Score, Dana Vega's objective on screen.
